summary:
Status: complete.

Inter v4.1 (OFL) installed, verified visible to the system, and the reskinned app relaunched against the isolated test vault.

What was done:
- Deleted the garbage `/tmp/inter-gf.zip` (confirmed HTML, not a zip).
- Installed Inter from source (1), rsms/inter GitHub release: downloaded `https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/download/v4.1/Inter-4.1.zip` (33 MB, valid zip) and copied 20 files user-level into `~/Library/Fonts/` (no sudo): 18 static OTFs (`Inter-Regular.otf`, `Inter-Italic.otf`, `Inter-Bold.otf`, … through Thin/Black + italics) plus `InterVariable.ttf` and `InterVariable-Italic.ttf`. Brew fallback not needed.
- Verified app sees it: `fc-list` lists the new Inter faces.
- Relaunched isolated app: `HOME=/tmp/fakehome nohup /Users/sachinkoli/github/noteapp/target/debug/bref >/tmp/bref-review.log 2>&1 &` — running as pid 35822, clean (empty) log. Test config (`/tmp/fakehome/.../bref/config` → `/tmp/bt`) and vault (`Welcome.md`, `Hi guys.md`) were already intact, left as-is.

Proof:
- `ls ~/Library/Fonts | grep -i inter` → 20 Inter files (18× `.otf` + 2× variable `.ttf`).
- `fc-list | grep -i '^.*Inter' | head -3` → `Inter-ExtraBoldItalic.otf: Inter,Inter ExtraBold…`, `Inter-ExtraBold.otf: Inter,Inter ExtraBold…`, plus a SignPainter line (false positive — "Pa**inter**" matches the loose grep).
- `pgrep` → pid 35822, `STAT SN`, alive; `/tmp/bref-review.log` empty.

Failures / notes for the caller:
- The brief's API URL `https://api.github.com/rsms/inter/releases/latest` is wrong (404, not rate-limiting) — the correct path is `https://api.github.com/repos/rsms/inter/releases/latest`, which works fine.
- `docs/font-files/` in rsms/inter holds only `.woff2` (unusable for install) — used the `Inter-4.1.zip` release asset's `extras/otf/` + variable TTFs instead.
- WARNING: `pkill -f 'noteapp/target/debug/bref'` matches my own subagent process, since the task text (containing that path) is embedded in its command line. I did not run the broad kill; I verified via exact-match (`pgrep -f 'target/debug/bref$'` + `ps aux`) that no real bref process was running before relaunching. Do not use the bare `-f` pattern in future dispatches.
- Constraints honored: no sudo, repo (`/Users/sachinkoli/github/noteapp`) and `~/github/bref` untouched, no cargo run, real `~/Library/Application Support/bref` untouched.
